description: Always Show Approvals compatibility test. P2 — tests approval Events, entity access, and Osiris integration.
assertions: assert((function() for _,u in ipairs(Ext.Mod.GetLoadOrder()) do local m=Ext.Mod.GetMod(u); local n=string.gsub(string.lower((m and m.Info and m.Info.Name) or ''), '[%s_%-]', ''); if string.find(n, 'alwaysshowapprovals', 1, true) then return true end end return false end)(), 'Always Show Approvals present in load order')

assert((function() local id=Ext.Events.ApprovalChanged:Subscribe(function() end); local ok=type(id) == 'number'; Ext.Events.ApprovalChanged:Unsubscribe(id); return ok end)(), 'ApprovalChanged event subscribe roundtrip executes')

assert((function() local entities=Ext.Entity.GetAllEntitiesWithComponent('eoc::character::CharacterComponent'); return type(entities) == 'table' and #entities > 0 end)(), 'loaded-save character entity query executes')
notes: Does not require MCM. Tests UI hooks and the Events system.
